string.text: The spook layer. It stays silent in safe and mundane places and, only where a place is genuinely unsettling, fires curated spook one-shots that grow closer and denser the worse it gets. It plays nothing else - no weather, no nature - and never replaces the base ambience.
Volume multiplier for every spook one-shot.
Scales the whole spook response. Higher makes places read as unsettling sooner and reach peak more often; lower keeps spooks rarer and milder.
Wait between one-shots. Higher plays them less often.
How far the one-shots spawn. Higher is farther and quieter.
At peak spook, in the worst places, a brief and subtle screen distortion.
In the worst places, a brief, subtle screen distortion that lasts a couple of seconds. Off disables the visual layer entirely; sound is unaffected.
Tracing and the debug HUD for tuning the spook layer. No effect on gameplay.
Records the spook score, grade and each one-shot to alifespooks.log with place and context. Use to diagnose the soundscape.
Write every line immediately. Slower; use only when hunting a crash.

Adds a "spooks" tab to the PDA: an audition player that browses every shipped sound off disk and plays it at a chosen distance, plus a spot inspector for marking dread coordinates. A dev tool, off by default. Players never see it unless enabled here.

A live on-screen breakdown of the spook calculation - grade, score, place, what is playing, each term and the gates - for tuning. Refreshes twice per second, hides while the PDA is open. Pick a corner to show it; Off hides it. Players never see it unless enabled here.
Restore all AlifeSpooks MCM settings to defaults. Use after upgrading from a version with a different MCM structure.
Warning: save or discard pending MCM changes first, otherwise they override the reset on the next Accept.
AlifeSpooks: all settings restored to defaults.
